custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with nothing on hand: its only bin holds 0.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425638-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425638-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and part A reads "Not Tracked".

Step 4:

  • Part History opens. Its newest entry reads "Tracking turned off", with your name under Staff and today's date and time, even though the part holds nothing.

Step 5:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch off.

Step 8:

  • The switch turns on.

Step 9:

  • The window closes and part A shows a quantity again.

Step 10:

  • The newest entry reads "Tracking turned on" and the one below it "Tracking turned off", each with your name, today's date and its own time.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part), story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S5-R11: “The change is recorded in Part History (S10-R22).”
  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”
